entries.previousBehavior: Only hello() and an empty test scaffold; no inventory or implemented Discord integration.
entries.currentBehavior: Versioned discovery inventory, structural validator, capability matrix, local feasibility probes and named upstream blockers. No Discord operation has been implemented.
entries.affectedPayloads: All discovered upstream surfaces are inventoried as unsupported; this baseline introduces no runtime payload behavior.
entries.migration: No consumer migration required; the original runtime scaffold remains. Future support entries must link symbols and tests.

entries.previousBehavior: A hello() greeting and empty runtime test scaffold; only development tooling and feasibility probes had meaningful verification.
entries.currentBehavior: Independent Bits, Core and Transport products provide local portable values, safe diagnostics, bounded bodies and injectable I/O contracts with deterministic test support. No Discord operation or network adapter is implemented.
entries.affectedPayloads: Local primitive formats and field-presence representations only; discovery inventory operation statuses remain unsupported.
breakingChanges: Declare documented Apple deployment minima in Package.swift.
entries.migration: Remove greeting calls and adopt the portable products as needed. Use JSONValue.parse/serialized for lossless numeric data; generic Codable numeric decoding is intentionally refused.

entries.previousBehavior: Portable values and injectable I/O protocols with deterministic scripted implementations; no production network adapters.
entries.currentBehavior: Independent Foundation and NIO network adapters, Unix IPC, app-reported Apple lifecycle ownership and injectable fenced shard leases. Local macOS conformance and bounded HTTP load evidence; no Discord endpoint or Gateway session implemented.
entries.affectedPayloads: Generic HTTP/1.1, RFC 6455 frames, datagrams and Unix byte streams only; no Discord operation statuses or payload schemas change.
entries.migration: Adopt a concrete adapter product explicitly and inject through DiscordTransport. Consume or close bodies and close owned adapters. No automatic redirects, replay or retry; prior protocol consumers need no source migration.

entries.previousBehavior: Portable values and owned generic transports; no Discord operation or Gateway session implementation.
entries.currentBehavior: Bounded HTTP policy, partial typed current-user/current-application retrieval and Gateway discovery; supervised JSON v10 shard lifecycle with startup coordination and fenced ownership. No full catalog or distributed adapter claim.
entries.affectedPayloads: GET /users/@me and /applications/@me partial typed User/Application responses; GET /gateway/bot discovery; JSON Gateway v10 Identify/Resume/Hello/heartbeat/ACK/reconnect/invalid-session and bounded raw dispatch ingestion.
breakingChanges: Exhaustive switches over MutationUncertainty must handle serverErrorAfterSubmission.
entries.migration: New products are opt-in. Inject shared opaque authentication identity and rate/order authority across clients; explicitly own and close transport/coalescer/coordinator. Existing WebSocketConnection implementations remain compatible; optional session capability enables close codes and Resume. Exhaustive MutationUncertainty switches must handle serverErrorAfterSubmission for unsafe HTTP 5xx outcomes.

entries.previousBehavior: Broad discovery membership validation with file-name implementation evidence; partial User/Application projections and HTTP descriptors handwritten.
entries.currentBehavior: Versioned reviewed per-field contracts, stable provenance/symbol/evidence links, deterministic offline model/endpoint/documentation/fixture/parity generation, nonwriting drift and semantic parity checks. Runtime operation support is unchanged.
entries.affectedPayloads: Existing partial API v10 User/Application responses and current-user/current-application descriptors; Gateway discovery is mapped as handwritten. No new operation or full-model parity claim.
entries.migration: Consumer calls remain compatible. Maintainers edit reviewed definitions, explicitly generate --write, review output and run root/tooling checks. Unknown inventory metadata keys now fail validation; opaque upstream definition metadata remains permitted.

entries.previousBehavior: Only partial current-user/current-application retrieval and Gateway discovery had typed descriptors.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors for all message/poll routes, request/response models, component validation, bounded streaming uploads, finite search/pagination and explicit bulk deletion. Related-family projections and batches5B-5J remain partial/pending.
entries.affectedPayloads: API v10 messages, polls, components, search indexing/results, pins, reactions and multipart attachments.
entries.migration: New opt-in Models/HTTP APIs; migrate deprecated pin descriptors to current paginated routes. Retain immutable flags and all desired attachments on edits.

entries.previousBehavior: Channel/thread endpoints and fields were unsupported; related message-family payloads retained partial raw projections.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors for all 24 documented Channel operations and active guild threads, complete channel-owned response fields and variants, validated type-specific settings and forum messages, bounded uploads and invite CSV, correct recipient auth and lazy member/archive workflows. Referenced resource families and batches 5C-5J remain partial or pending.
entries.affectedPayloads: API v10 channels, overwrites, threads, forum/media initial messages, member/archive envelopes, channel invites and recipient tokens.
entries.migration: New opt-in Models/HTTP APIs. Use explicit channel-type edit context, separate recipient gdm.join token, withMember true for v10 member pagination and operation-specific archive timestamp or ID cursors. No source-incompatible change to existing symbols.

entries.previousBehavior: Guild operations unsupported except active threads from 5B and referenced partial raw projections.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors for all 45 current Guild operations, reusing active threads; guild-owned response fields/variants and request validation, roles/counts, members/bans, integrations/widgets, onboarding/welcome/incidents, explicit screening pending state, lazy traversal and correlated partial bulk-ban plans. Related families and 5D-5J remain partial/pending.
entries.affectedPayloads: REST v10 Guild, preview, member, role/colors/tags/counts, bans/bulk partial outcomes, prune, regions, integrations, public widget JSON/PNG, vanity, welcome/onboarding and incidents.
entries.migration: Opt into Models/HTTP APIs, use separate guilds.join user consent for member adds, prefer current-member nickname and role colors, share rate/reuse authorities; guild mutations invalidate message visibility snapshots within the authentication identity.

entries.previousBehavior: Audit Log and Auto Moderation resource operations unsupported.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors expose all six current written-reference operations: Audit Log retrieval with own-field contracts and partial referenced families; full Auto Moderation list/get/create/modify/delete schemas and validated payloads. Bounded directional audit continuation and explicit snapshot no-op rule reconciliation preserve shared rate/reuse ownership. Gateway catalogs, referenced family completion and 5E-5J remain separate.
entries.affectedPayloads: REST v10 audit envelope, heterogeneous changes, optional string-valued options, exact action codes, Auto Moderation rule/trigger/action snapshots and validated create/modify request metadata.
entries.migration: Opt into Models/HTTP resource APIs, keep shared identity-scoped rate/reuse authorities, select explicit audit cursor direction and treat snapshot reconciliation as advisory. MANAGE_GUILD is required for Auto Moderation; timeout additionally needs MODERATE_MEMBERS.

entries.previousBehavior: Emoji, Sticker and Soundboard operations unsupported; messages/polls/guilds retained explicitly partial related projections.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors expose all 25 current written-reference operations: ten Emoji, eight Sticker and seven Soundboard, including guild/application ownership, sticker packs, direct multipart creation, default/guild sounds and play. Complete written resource-owned fields, bounded media, scoped reuse/invalidation and explicit snapshot reconciliation retain independent HTTP adoption. Referenced User projections and Gateway events remain partial or pending; 5F-5J remain separate.
entries.affectedPayloads: REST v10 Unicode/deleted/animated Emoji and application items envelope; Sticker types/formats/packs and direct multipart create; Soundboard default/guild assets, items envelope, JSON data-URI creates and voice-channel play requests.
entries.migration: Opt into Models/HTTP expression endpoints and explicit snapshot reconciliation; preserve shared identity-scoped authorities, current expression permissions and actual voice eligibility for play. File-size validation does not establish codec, dimensions/duration, premium access or role classification. Application emoji rename accepts omitted name per explicit preview compatibility, rejects null and retains the String convenience initializer.

entries.previousBehavior: Channel invite creation/listing and Guild invite listing were available with partial related projections; Invite target-user jobs, Guild Template, Guild Scheduled Event and Stage Instance resource operations were unsupported.
entries.currentBehavior: Typed descriptors expose all 25 current written-reference family operations: nine Invite, six Guild Template, six Guild Scheduled Event and four Stage Instance, reusing existing channel/guild invite operations. Resource-owned fields, typed partial invite guild/role snapshots, template integer placeholders, recurrence and status validation, bounded CSV ownership/jobs and lazy user continuation preserve independent HTTP adoption. Related User/Application projections and corresponding Gateway catalogs remain partial or pending; 5G-5J and existing qualification gates remain separate.
entries.affectedPayloads: REST v10 invite retrieval/deletion, target-user CSV and asynchronous jobs, target-user single/bulk mutations; template snapshots, CRUD and sync; scheduled-event voice/stage/external variants, recurrence/status transitions, subscriber pagination and optional preview RSVP/exception projections; stage instance CRUD with deprecated response privacy retained.
breakingChanges: ChannelInvite.guild, guildScheduledEvent and roles now expose typed Guild/Role/Event projections rather than MessageRelatedResource wrappers; explicit old type annotations require adjustment.
entries.migration: Opt into Models/HTTP descriptors and explicit bounded continuations; share credential-scoped rate/reuse authorities and preserve CSV header user_id. Template IDs are local integer placeholders and cannot authorize live resource operations. Event creation requires CREATE_EVENTS and type-specific channel permissions; stage mutation requires moderator permissions. Snapshot reconciliation performs no hidden reads and does not prove current authorization. Replace explicit MessageRelatedResource annotations for ChannelInvite guild/roles/event fields with their typed projection names; rawFields continues to retain exact original payloads.
